label: Handyman / repairs
about: Small jobs and home repairs: furniture assembly, hanging shelves, painting, fixing doors and more.
service_area: City centre and surrounding areas (up to 15 km)
booking_question: What jobs do you need doing? A short list is fine. Include your address or area.

faqs.q: Do you bring your own tools? | tools | materials
faqs.a: Yes, we bring all the tools. Materials like paint or shelves can be bought by you or by us (charged at cost).

faqs.q: Can you do several small jobs in one visit? | list of jobs | multiple jobs
faqs.a: Yes, that's the best way to do it. Send us your list and we'll estimate how long it takes.

faqs.q: Do you give free quotes? | do you charge for quotes | free estimate
faqs.a: Yes, send us a description or photos and we'll give you a free estimate.

faqs.q: How do I pay? | payment methods | card | cash
faqs.a: Card, cash or bank transfer when the job is done.
